title: Two controls for cs_aro_hp's in-profit add: capital-matched leverage (cs_aro_lev2) and the unconditional add (cs_aro_hpany)
label: PROVISIONAL -- one era (2023-26), seed 1; follows cs_aro_lev INCONCLUSIVE (62ec301a). Nothing adopted.
why: cs_aro_lev (x1.3187) failed its instrument: 68% of cs_aro entries are already at the fillable cap (quote volume / 10 of the entry candle), so stake scaling reached only 0.86 of cs_aro_hp's capital. The add gets capital by filling on a later candle.
k_rule: 1.7432 solved on cs_aro's own trades (timings fixed): sum min(k x 900 x w, quote_volume/10 of the candle before entry) x hours = 1.3187 x cs_aro's stake-hours; the cap model reproduces cs_aro and cs_aro_lev stakes to <= 0.3% (2nd-98th pct). Exposure only; no P&L used. Wallet cap ignored in the solve (applies in the backtest)

instrument.cs_aro_lev2: time-weighted average committed stake / cs_aro_hp's within [0.90, 1.10] in each half; 0 adds; >= 95% of trades shared with cs_aro have stake within 1% of min(k x intended, fillable cap)
instrument.cs_aro_hpany: adds in both halves; > 0 adds on a trade NOT in profit (the condition is really off); 0 exits on an add candle; agree share within 0.05 of cs_aro's
instrument.fail: that arm INCONCLUSIVE, no P&L read for it

pass.lev2: judge_one(cs_aro_hp, cs_aro_lev2) PASS -> the in-profit add beats capital-matched leverage
pass.hpany: judge_one(cs_aro_hp, cs_aro_hpany) PASS -> the in-profit condition beats the unconditional add
pass.rule: each: both half gains > 0, paired not WORSENED, Sharpe / maxDD not WORSENED; small-margin rule. Two separate decisions
